UserName.description: The user name associated with the SNMP or SMTP subscription entry.
UserName.longDescription: This property shall contain the user name associated with the SNMP trap or SMTP subscription entry. For SNMPv3, this identifies the USM user. For SMTP, this identifies the mail recipient user.

SendTestAlert.description: This action sends a test SNMP trap or SMTP alert to the configured destination.
SendTestAlert.longDescription: This action shall send a test SNMP trap or SMTP alert to the event destination configured in the subscription slot. The slot must already be configured with a valid destination address.
